name: GetFileDriveAndItemId
description: Retrieves the Drive ID and Item ID for a specified file in OneDrive or SharePoint using the Microsoft 365 API. Provide valid M365 credentials and the file URL. The connector will return the Drive ID and Item ID, along with the status code and message from the API.
author: @gaurav

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: The M365 credential containing valid tenant ID, client ID, and client secret which is used to authenticate API requests.

fields.name: FileUrl
fields.label: File URL
fields.description: The URL of the file in OneDrive or SharePoint.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the Drive ID and Item ID of the specified file.
